# requirements.txt's own == pins cover only DIRECT dependencies — nothing
# hash-verified or version-pinned the transitive tree (numpy/scipy/soundfile/
# librosa/mutagen/pillow's own dependencies), so a fresh install resolved
# whatever transitive versions PyPI served at install time. backend-tests.yml
# installs from this file with `pip install --require-hashes` instead of
# `pip install -r requirements.txt` directly, so CI verifies every package
